item.title: Gunsmoke - The Avengers
item.description: A judge and his two sons plot their revenge when they suspect Festus and Kitty of murdering a member of their family.

item.title: The Waltons - The Chicken Thief
item.description: A local "Robin Hood"" who steals from the ""haves"" and gives to the ""have-nots"" causes a crisis of conscience for John-Boy "

item.title: Hawaii Five-O - A Bullet for McGarrett
item.description: A university professor is using hypnosis to program students into becoming assassins.

item.title: Matlock - Heist, The (Part 2)
item.description: Matlock and Jerri head out to the beach with Billy and Cliff as Cliff prepares for an upcoming triathlon. Matlock runs into retired F.B.I. agent Ed Wingate, who is investigating a case. When one of the people Wingate is investigating is found dead, Matlock agrees to defend his old friend.

item.title: Perry Mason - The Case of the Unwelcome Bride
item.description: Wealthy Walter Frazer has always blamed his daughter-in-law, Sue Ellen, for the failures of his son, Gregson. You can only imagine how he feels when Sue Ellen is accused of Gregson's murder.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - The Yard Bird
item.description: Ward doesn't take any excuses when he puts his foot down and demands that Wally and Beaver clean the yard. They each reluctantly cancel their plans with Richard and Eddie and get to work but soon find themselves with distractions. This causes them to miss the deadline to call the hauler who is suppose to take all the yard waste away and this leads them to pay Eddie and Lumpy to take care of it.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - Brother Versus Brother
item.description: Beaver gets a new girl in his class and is instantly smitten. He begins walking her home from school but he soon realizes that the girl has an agenda on her mind. Her sole purpose is to get close to Beaver in order to get close to Wally. This leads Beaver to accuse Wally of stealing his girl.

item.title: Toon In With Me - On This Day...February 6th
item.description: Toon In With Me - On This Day...February 6th

item.title: Adam-12 - Log 65: Cigarettes, Cars and Wild, Wild Women
item.description: Reed and Malloy help take down a chop-shop that employs cute girls in mini-skirts to steal cars from trusting men. They also arrest a young man who grows pot and holds parties in the home of his unsuspecting shut-in aunt.

item.title: Adam-12 - Log 45: Bright Boy
item.description: Reed and Malloy report to a burglary call that was witnessed by a boy with a photographic memory. Afterward, they are called to the scene of two drunk men shooting at a box of dynamite at close range in a residential area.
